# Quentin Nivelais

> Web3 Infrastructure Architect & Account Abstraction Specialist. CTO at Frak Labs. Deep technical articles on blockchain, smart contracts, and infrastructure.

This is the personal portfolio and technical blog of Quentin Nivelais (CTO at Frak Labs). Content is written for engineers working on blockchain infrastructure, account abstraction (ERC-4337 / ERC-7579), WebAuthn & passkeys, smart contracts, and production DevOps.

## Site sections

- [Home](https://nivelais.com/): Portfolio overview, latest articles, selected work.
- [All articles](https://nivelais.com/articles/): Complete archive of 40+ engineering deep-dives.
- [Projects](https://nivelais.com/projects/): Real-world systems with role and architecture notes.
- [RSS feed](https://nivelais.com/rss.xml): Full-text article feed.

## Cooking Bot

- [Real-Time AI Conversations and Audio Processing](https://nivelais.com/articles/cooking-bot/runtime/): Deep dive into our runtime LLM architecture, speech synthesis pipeline, and observability systems that power conversational cooking guidance.
- [Safety-First AI for Food Systems](https://nivelais.com/articles/cooking-bot/introduction/): Building deterministic safety layers with hybrid NLP, streaming architecture, and rule-based allergen detection for health-critical AI applications.
- [The Sophisticated Recipe Processing Pipeline](https://nivelais.com/articles/cooking-bot/ingestion/): Deep dive into our 7-stage recipe processing pipeline with intelligent routing, cost optimization, and comprehensive safety mechanisms.

## Frak Labs

- [Passkey Recovery That Survives App Uninstalls in Tauri](https://nivelais.com/articles/mobile/tauri-recovery-hint-uninstall-survival/): Persist passkey recovery hints through app uninstalls with a Tauri plugin: NSUbiquitousKeyValueStore, iCloud Keychain, Google Block Store, Auto Backup.
- [Rich Native Share Sheets for Tauri on iOS and Android](https://nivelais.com/articles/mobile/tauri-native-sharing-rich-previews/): Build a native Tauri share plugin for iOS and Android: rich URL preview cards via LPLinkMetadata, FileProvider thumbnails, and a bounded image race.
- [Native WebAuthn Passkeys for Tauri on iOS and Android](https://nivelais.com/articles/mobile/native-webauthn-tauri-plugin-ios-android/): Build a custom Tauri plugin exposing native WebAuthn passkeys on iOS and Android: platform APIs, CBOR and COSE key parsing, and the TLS dev workaround.
- [A Fast WordPress + WooCommerce Plugin in Production](https://nivelais.com/articles/frak/wordpress-plugin-performance-native-webhooks/): How we shipped a production WordPress and WooCommerce plugin with near-zero request cost, manifest-based block registration, and native webhooks.
- [Our WebAuthN Smart Wallet Demo: What We Built and Why](https://nivelais.com/articles/frak/webauthn-release/): How we built our first WebAuthn smart wallet POC: ERC-4337 accounts secured by biometrics, a paywall-replacement demo, and the architecture behind it.
- [DevX Overhaul: Cutting Build Times by 10x at Frak](https://nivelais.com/articles/frak/wallet-devx-revolution/): How we migrated a monorepo from Next.js to TanStack Start, adopted Rolldown, unified on Vitest, and got the full deploy pipeline under 4 minutes.
- [Shopify i18n: One Metaobject Source for Four Runtimes](https://nivelais.com/articles/frak/shopify-i18n-metaobjects/): A Shopify app's banner, share button, and checkout card localized from one frak_i18n metaobject, plugged into Shopify's Translate & Adapt.
- [Account Abstraction on Polygon With ERC-4337](https://nivelais.com/articles/frak/polygon-account-abstraction/): How Frak moved from MPC wallets to ERC-4337 account abstraction on Polygon with ZeroDev and Pimlico, and what the transition taught us.
- [Replacing MongoDB With libSQL and RustFS on Kubernetes](https://nivelais.com/articles/frak/mongodb-to-turso-rustfs/): How we retired our last MongoDB dependency by running sqld (libSQL) and RustFS on Kubernetes, with bottomless replication and a 7-line Drizzle schema.
- [Giving a Smart Wallet a Bank Account With Monerium](https://nivelais.com/articles/frak/monerium-onchain-iban/): How we gave Frak's self-custodial smart wallet a real IBAN via Monerium: OAuth2 with PKCE, ERC-1271 linking, delegated KYC, and a signed EURe off-ramp.
- [Migrating Solidity Testing from Hardhat to Foundry](https://nivelais.com/articles/frak/hardhat-to-foundry/): Evaluating the performance difference of Hardhat and Foundry for Solidity contract unit testing & reason behind the switch
- [Rebuilding the Wallet's CI: From 9 Minutes to 2](https://nivelais.com/articles/frak/frak-wallet-ci-overhaul/): How we cut wallet CI from 9 minutes to 2: killing Dockerfile.base, in-cluster BuildKit, a Zot registry cache, and shared apt and bun caches across six images.
- [Ring Architecture: A Wallet That Costs Nothing to Embed](https://nivelais.com/articles/frak/frak-listener-ring-architecture/): How our embedded wallet boots from a 3-chunk eager bundle: React to Preact, eager/lazy ring splitting, and SDK prefetching of lazy chunks.
- [Why We Chose SST and Pulumi over Terraform for IaC](https://nivelais.com/articles/frak/frak-infrastructure-iac/): Why Frak abandoned HCL for TypeScript: multi-cloud infrastructure with SST and Kubernetes cluster management with Pulumi.
- [A Self-Hosted Hetzner CI Platform for the Frak Stack](https://nivelais.com/articles/frak/frak-hetzner-platform/): How we self-hosted CI on Hetzner: in-cluster GitHub runners, BuildKit over mTLS, a Zot OCI registry, and a Verdaccio NPM mirror on k3s.
- [How We Cut Our Wallet Size by 30%: Frontend Optimization](https://nivelais.com/articles/frak/frak-frontend-optimization/): How we cut our embedded wallet bundle by 30% by migrating Jotai to Zustand, splitting wallet from listener, and self-hosting Nginx over AWS S3.
- [Cost-Effective Blockchain Infrastructure: eRPC and Ponder](https://nivelais.com/articles/frak/cost-effective-infra/): How Frak runs automated on-chain reward distribution on Arbitrum within a tight budget, using eRPC for RPC routing and Ponder for on-chain indexing.
- [WebAuthn Signatures for ERC-4337 Smart Wallets](https://nivelais.com/articles/frak/4337-webauthn/): How we validate ERC-4337 user operations with WebAuthn signatures: P256 passkeys, the FCL on-chain verifier, and paymaster gas simulation.
- [Bun Memory Leak on Kubernetes: 3 Days to a Pod Restart](https://nivelais.com/articles/devops/bun-memory-leak-kubernetes-restart/): Debug a Bun RSS memory leak on a Elysia.js backend in Kubernetes: forced GC, heap snapshots, and why a lying health endpoint and pod restart won.

## Pico Kiln

- [Pico Kiln Part 4: Physics-Based PID Tuning in Python](https://nivelais.com/articles/kiln/pico-python-analysis/): Tune a kiln PID controller with physics-based phase detection, FOPDT thermal modeling, and Ziegler-Nichols, Cohen-Coon, and AMIGO tuning methods.
- [Pico Kiln - Part 5: Dropping to the Metal with Rust](https://nivelais.com/articles/kiln/pico-kiln-rust/): Migrating kiln firmware from MicroPython to bare-metal Rust on the RP2350: a compile-time safety wall, golden-replay tests, and MSPLIM stack guards.
- [Pico Kiln - Part 2: Firmware Architecture](https://nivelais.com/articles/kiln/pico-kiln-firmware/): Deep dive into the dual-core control logic, PID implementation with Adaptive Gain Scheduling, and thread-safe communication on the Raspberry Pi Pico W.
- [Pico Kiln - Part 3: From Web to Native with Tauri](https://nivelais.com/articles/kiln/pico-kiln-app/): Ship one React kiln controller UI as a web app, macOS app, and Android APK with Tauri, and bypass the HTTP/HTTPS mixed-content problem entirely.
- [Pico Kiln Part 1: Converting a 380V Kiln to 220V](https://nivelais.com/articles/kiln/kiln-hardware/): Rewiring a 1977 pottery kiln from 380V three-phase power to 220V single-phase: star-to-parallel element conversion, breaker sizing, and ground faults.

## Web3 & Solidity

- [Securing Solidity Smart Contracts](https://nivelais.com/articles/web3/securing-solidity-smart-contracts/): Set up free Solidity security tooling in Docker: Slither, Mythril, Manticore, and Echidna to catch issues before a paid audit.
- [ERC-2612 Part 3: Unit Testing with Hardhat and Forge](https://nivelais.com/articles/web3/erc-2612-part-3/): Perfecting ERC-2612: Boost Your DeFi Skills with Solidity Unit Testing in Hardhat and Forge
- [ERC-2612 Part 2: Solidity Implementation with EIP-712](https://nivelais.com/articles/web3/erc-2612-part-2/): A deep dive into the Solidity code of gasless ERC-20 approvals ERC-2612
- [ERC-2612 Part 1: How Gasless ERC-20 Approvals Work](https://nivelais.com/articles/web3/erc-2612-part-1/): How to use EIP-712 signatures to save gas, batch approvals and increase security for your ERC-20 tokens.
- [ERC-7579 Modular Smart Wallets: The Uncomfortable Truth](https://nivelais.com/articles/opinion/erc7579-uncomfortable-truth/): Two weeks building a ZK social login wallet on ERC-7579 modules: the tech works, but the ecosystem's registry checks, SDKs, and docs don't.

## Scenario Parser

- [Beyond Text: Modeling Character Psychology with LLMs](https://nivelais.com/articles/scenario-parser/scenario-parser-psychology/): A technical deep dive into prompt engineering, multi-pass architecture, and the 'Big Five' personality synthesis in scenario-parser.
- [The Orchestration Engine: A Resilient LLM Pipeline](https://nivelais.com/articles/scenario-parser/scenario-parser-pipeline/): A deep dive into the event-driven architecture, concurrency control, and graph theory algorithms powering scenario-parser's analysis engine.
- [From PDF to Structured Data: The Extraction Layer](https://nivelais.com/articles/scenario-parser/scenario-parser-extraction/): How scenario-parser transforms raw PDF binaries into semantic screenplay data using PyMuPDF4LLM, heuristic state machines, and fuzzy string matching.
- [Scenario Parser: The Complete Architecture](https://nivelais.com/articles/scenario-parser/architecture/): How scenario-parser parses screenplays with a 3-stage pipeline: PDF extraction, four competing parsing strategies, quality selection, and LLM analysis.

## L'Atelier

- [L'Atelier Infrastructure: CLIProxy, Verdaccio, Zot and Helm](https://nivelais.com/articles/side-projects/atelier-supporting-infrastructure/): How L'Atelier runs CLIProxy for LLM rate limits, shared binary volumes, a Verdaccio npm cache, an in-cluster Zot registry, and one Helm chart to install it all.
- [L'Atelier: Stop Babysitting Your AI Agents](https://nivelais.com/articles/side-projects/atelier-stop-babysitting/): A self-hosted Firecracker orchestrator that gives every AI coding agent its own VM sandbox: dispatch tasks like a kanban board, review results anywhere.
- [L'Atelier: Dispatch AI Agents from Slack with an MCP Server](https://nivelais.com/articles/side-projects/atelier-slack-mcp/): How L'Atelier dispatches AI coding agents from Slack: an MCP server, an AI dispatcher in a sandboxed VM, and live progress updates in the thread.
- [L'Atelier: Migrating Firecracker Sandboxes to Kubernetes](https://nivelais.com/articles/side-projects/atelier-kubernetes-migration/): How I replaced a custom Firecracker orchestrator with k3s and Kata Containers: 8,702 lines deleted, TopoLVM snapshots, and portable sandbox infrastructure.

## Side Projects

- [WordForge: AI-Powered WordPress Management via MCP](https://nivelais.com/articles/side-projects/wordforge/): An open-source MCP server for WordPress and WooCommerce: manage posts, media, and products through Claude or OpenCode instead of the admin panel.
- [A 3-Phase Electrical Panel Optimizer for NF C 15-100](https://nivelais.com/articles/side-projects/tableau-elec-3-phase-optimizer/): I built a tool that models a French home electrical installation, auto-generates sub-panels, and optimizes breaker counts and 3-phase balance under NF C 15-100.
